====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

INTRODUCTION
----
Look around a shamba in Nyeri. Number puzzle shows up in small daily actions — this page names them clearly. In plain words: fix the wrong answer for Number puzzle in MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES.

MAIN NOTES
----
• Fix the Wrong Answer — Number puzzle belongs to number and measurement work in mathematics.
• Always show the method: write what you know → choose an operation or formula → substitute → compute → check.
• Example numbers for this page: 4 and 7 (sum 11, product 28).
• Place value reminder: read each digit’s place carefully in numbers like 494.
• Units matter: write cm, m, Ksh, or items so the answer matches the question.

WORKED EXAMPLE
----
Worked situation at a shamba in Nyeri:
A trader sells 10 items at Ksh 45 each. Find the total.

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Total = number × amount each
2. Substitute values: Total = 10 × 45
3. Total = 450
Final Answer: 450 (count equal groups to check)
Mark reminder: method mark for multiplication; accuracy mark for answer

Wrong path to avoid: adding 10 + 45 = 55 when equal groups need multiplication.
